verdict.rationale: YPOG's own pages say it is one of Germany's market leaders in structuring PE/VC funds, counts VC funds, family offices and business angels among its transaction clients, and advises founders, startups and investors. Its webinar on German venture deals covers "notable key market-standard investment terms," which supports two-sided market-terms knowledge. However, every item is a first-party claim, and its investor-side work on financing rounds (as opposed to fund formation) is mostly implied rather than shown through named deals. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, named investor-side deal examples, and a published market-terms survey or data showing two-sided term knowledge.
